text: Canonical boundary: reframe4s-lie owns validated frame-directed Rigid3/SE(3); reframe4s-motion owns pose series, timing, estimator, application, and pose-derived diagnostics. ScalaFIM retains NeuroVec/BIDS/report/CLI adapters, DVARS, censoring, confounds, and other fMRI policy. Legacy spacing-only sampling and Euler-column smoothing are correction fixtures, not parity authorities.
